quarterly_data.quarter: AstraZeneca press release: Tagrisso plus Orpathys demonstrated statistically (09-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Positive high-level results from the SANOVO Phase III trial in China (conducted by HUTCHMED): Tagrisso (osimertinib, 80mg once daily) plus Orpathys (savolitinib, 300/200mg twice daily by body weight) showed a statistically significant and highly clinically meaningful improvement in investigator-assessed progression-free survival (primary endpoint) versus Tagrisso alone in treatment-naive patients with EGFR-mutated (exon 19 deletion or L858R) locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC and MET overexpression, in both the high MET (IHC 3+) and the intention-to-treat (IHC 2+, IHC 3+) populations. In both populations the combination also showed very encouraging overall survival benefit (secondary endpoint), with follow-up continuing. The trial randomised 326 patients 1:1; safety was consistent with each medicine's known profile with no new safety findings, and the data will be presented at a forthcoming medical meeting and shared with regulatory authorities (HUTCHMED's CEO said the aim is to bring the combination to the 1st-line setting in China). SANOVO extends the combination into 1st line after the SACHI approval in China and the positive global SAFFRON trial in the post-Tagrisso setting.
